primary.title: ITR portal: Govt says managed service provider was penalised in FY26 for outages and due date extension
primary.summary: The government penalised the MSP of the income tax e-filing portal for an extension of the ITR filing deadline caused by technical issues in FY 2025-26. Here's why an extension this year is unlikely.
